charred kitchen cabinets above stove; smoke damage on ceiling and walls

input.rationale: Fire damage to the claimant's own kitchen cabinets and smoke damage to ceilings and walls caused by the claimant's own stove malfunction is direct property damage to the claimant's own home, and is covered under the homeowners policy.

Localized fire damage to kitchen cabinets and smoke damage to ceiling and walls involves moderate property loss requiring restoration work, but no injuries occurred and damage is limited to one room with the rest of the house unaffected.

input.claim_summary: Policyholder: Alex Doe (POL-1001, Active Homeowners Policy, $500 deductible, $250K limit). Incident: Kitchen fire yesterday evening caused by grease flare-up on stove while sauteing; claimant extinguished with fire extinguisher. Damage: Charred kitchen cabinets above stove and smoke damage to ceiling and walls; no other rooms affected, no injuries. Classification: Property damage (confidence 1.0). Severity: Medium—moderate localized property loss requiring restoration but contained to one room with no injuries.
